description: MCP server that acts as an intelligent intermediary between AI clients and multiple MCP servers
name: io.github.stacklok/mcp-optimizer

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of ToolHive group names to filter tool lookups (default: no filtering)
environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_GROUPS

environmentVariables.description: Number of tools to return from find_tool (default: 8)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_TOOLS_TO_RETURN

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of tokens to return from call_tool (default: no limit)
environmentVariables.name: MAX_TOOL_RESPONSE_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Polling interval for running MCP servers (default: 60 seconds)
environmentVariables.name: WORKLOAD_POLLING_INTERVAL

environmentVariables.description: Polling interval for ToolHive registry (default: 24 hours)
environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_POLLING_INTERVAL

environmentVariables.description: Runtime mode for MCP servers (docker or k8s, default: docker)
environmentVariables.name: RUNTIME_MODE

title: mcp-optimizer
